title: Al-Baqarah 286: the du'as and their rules: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: Al-Baqarah 285 to 286; madd laazim and 'aarid
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 38 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Al-Baqarah 286 rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 38. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۚ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا ٱكْتَسَبَتْ ۗ رَبَّنَا لَا تُؤَاخِذْنَآ إِن نَّسِينَآ أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَآ إِصْرًۭا كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا ۚ رَبَّنَا وَلَا تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِۦ ۖ وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ ۚ أَنتَ مَوْلَىٰنَا فَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ (٢٨٦)

head: Du'a
What we ask
rows: Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we forget or err
Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us
Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear
Do not test us beyond our strength
And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us

questions.q: Recite «وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ» with the ghunnah on «عَنَّا».
questions.a: wa'fu 'an-naa wagh-fir lanaa warhamnaa: ghunnah two counts.

questions.q: Pupil PDF: match each du'a in 2:286 to its meaning and mark two rules in each. Today's rota group recites 2:286.
Extend: make these du'as after salah today, in Arabic, thinking of their meaning.

questions.a: We stop at the end of the ayah, so the last letter is sakin after a yaa madd.

questions.q: Which du'a asks Allah not to blame us if we forget?
questions.a: A) Rabbana la tu'akhidhna in nasina. It is the first du'a in 2:286.

questions.q: Think again: 2:286 contains several du'as. If you could ask Allah one thing from them, which would you choose?
questions.a: For example: 'Pardon us, forgive us and have mercy on us' («وَٱعْفُ عَنَّا وَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَآ»).
